title: 不定式与动名词
goal: 按动词搭配选择补语形式；用不定式表达动作目的。

points.label: 按动词搭配选择补语形式
用不定式表达动作目的

sources.title: 大学英语四级（CET-4）：课表
sources.used: 写作部分本课的内容范围、知识点及教学材料规格

sources.title: C2 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）
sources.used: 依据所给研究文件中的写作语言与连贯性要求安排教学，不陈述考试事实

body.p: 一句话里出现第二个动词时，它的形式由前面的动词或介词决定。表示另一个动作的目的，通常用 to 加动词原形。

body.box: The committee decided to invite a local designer to discuss the new entrance.

body.p: decided to invite 里的不定式说明决定的内容。to discuss 说明邀请的目的。两处形式相同，作用不同。

cards.title: 不定式补语
rows: want to do
表示想做某事。to 后用原形，不用过去式。
The student editors want to publish a short guide for new club members.
decide to do
表示作出决定。to 不能省。
The drama group decided to move its weekly rehearsal to a larger classroom.
plan to do
表示计划。后面不直接接动名词。
Our design team plans to test the new label with several student volunteers.
hope to do
表示希望做某事，后接 to 加原形。
The reading club hopes to attract more members through its monthly book exchange.

cards.title: 动名词补语
rows: enjoy doing
表示喜欢某项活动。不说 enjoy to do。
Several first-year students enjoy discussing short stories during the weekly reading group meeting.
avoid doing
表示避免某动作。后面不用原形。
The volunteers avoid blocking the narrow entrance when visitors arrive for the exhibition.
finish doing
表示做完某事。动名词后面照常带宾语。
The student team finished checking the equipment before the science fair opened yesterday.
consider doing
表示考虑某个做法，还没有决定。
The sports club is considering renting a smaller room for its committee meetings.

cards.title: 介词后的动名词
rows: by doing
表示方法。by 后不接不定式。
The organizers reduced confusion by printing the room number on every invitation card.
without doing
表示没有做某事。不说 without to do。
Students can compare the courses without entering any personal details on the website.
before doing
表示在某动作之前。两个动作是同一个人做的，用动名词。
The team checked the opening hours before arranging a visit to the gallery.
after doing
表示在某动作之后。它说的是先后，不是目的。
The committee revised the timetable after collecting comments from students in different departments.

cards.title: 不定式与动作目的
rows: to save time
说明做某事是为了节省时间。
The organizers prepared name labels in advance to save time at the reception.
to reduce costs
说明为了降低成本。不说 for reduce。
The club borrowed display boards from another department to reduce costs this term.
to collect feedback
说明为了收集反馈。收集反馈的人就是句子的主语。
The editors attached a short questionnaire to the newsletter to collect feedback from readers.
to improve access
说明为了方便使用。to 后用原形。
The department placed course information near the entrance to improve access for visitors.

body.box: Draft: The gardening society decided invite a trainer. Members enjoy learn practical skills. They arranged a demonstration to reduce mistakes during planting.

body.p: decided 后缺少 to。enjoy 后要用 learning。两个动词不能直接并列。

body.box: The gardening society decided to invite a trainer who could explain basic planting skills. Members enjoy learning practical skills during the society’s regular meetings in the garden.

body.p: 原稿的 to reduce mistakes 已经表示示范的目的，不用改成 reducing。用动名词还是不定式，每一处单独判断。

items.stem: Which phrase completes the sentence? The debate club decided ___ a training session before the regional event.
items.why: decided 后接不定式，即第二项 to hold。

items.stem: Which phrase completes the sentence? The volunteers enjoy ___ donated clothes into clearly marked boxes every Saturday.
items.why: enjoy 后接动名词，即第四项 sorting。

items.stem: Which phrase states a purpose? The team marked the cables ___ confusion during the evening performance.
items.why: 题干问目的。to avoid 说明标记电缆是为了避免混乱，即第一项。

items.stem: Which phrase expresses how the students checked the route? They checked it ___ along the full path.
items.why: 题干用 how 问方法。by walking 说明靠实际走一遍来检查，即第三项。

items.stem: Complete the sentence about the intended benefit of the labels.
items.why: to help 引出目的。visitors 是 help 的宾语，find 是参观者要做的事。

items.stem: Complete with the correct form of check: The group avoided ___ personal records.
items.why: 原文说 did not inspect personal records。avoided 后接动名词，填 checking。

groups.text: An archive group prepared an exhibition of old campus photographs. Members checked the dates on the labels but did not inspect personal records. The group attached labels so that visitors could find the correct display. It also borrowed tables from the history department for the exhibition.

items.stem: The robotics team decided ___ a replacement part before its next demonstration in the main hall.
items.why: decided 后接不定式，说明决定做什么，即第一项 to order。

items.stem: The costume group avoided ___ heavy fabric because the performers needed to move freely on stage.
items.why: avoided 后接动名词，即第二项 using。heavy fabric 是 using 的宾语。

items.stem: The student photographer moved closer ___ a clearer picture. Which completion expresses the intended result?
items.why: 题干问 intended result，要用表示目的的结构。to take 说明靠近是为了拍得更清楚，即第三项。

items.stem: The volunteers numbered the storage boxes ___ missing items. Which completion states their purpose?
items.why: 题干问目的。to locate 说明编号是为了找到缺少的物品，即第四项。第三项 by locating 表示方法。

items.stem: Complete the sentence about a plan for the student journal.
items.why: plan 后接 to publish。a collection of student interviews 是 publish 的宾语。

items.stem: Complete the sentence explaining the purpose of the extra signs.
items.why: to help 引出目的。guests 是 help 的宾语，find 的动作由 guests 完成。

items.stem: Use the correct form of share: The research partners enjoy ___ ideas during their weekly project meetings.
items.why: enjoy 后接动名词，填 sharing。

items.stem: Use the infinitive of reduce to express purpose: The workshop reused clean containers ___ packaging waste.
items.why: 题干要求用不定式表示目的，填 to reduce。
